title: I built a monthly decision making model - includes backtesting and stats
author: Homebody_quant
selftext:
Hello - I am reposting this since the last one had incorrect stats, and I wanted to refresh this.  

Always enjoyed the idea of AI and algo trading, and I wanted to share my results. This has been trading live since 1 April where its currently up +65%.  It has only been 3 months which is too early to tell how things will go, esp since it currently holds AI / semi / memory stocks that could easily go up or down 15%+ before the end of the month.

It is primarily a momentum strategy that compares itself to SPY and cash. It has a predictor that determines whether or not the momentum strategy can outperform SPY and cash. If it can beat both, it selects up to 10 stocks and holds them for up to a month, and if it thinks that SPY is better, then it will choose SPY for the month. If both fail, it goes to cash. The longest we hold is 1 month before another decision is made.

This model has been in development for the past 5 months or so, and uses OHLCV data.    I am still trying to find ways to improve it. It seems unlikely to see any more modest gains or drawdown improvements though.

Thanks!
